description: Intensity profiles for calibrated pushback in Conflict_Dojo. The persona's arousal and positional rigidity ARE the pushback; they are orchestrated by this profile, never a free-form personality trait. At levels 4-5 the persona escalates affect and deepens positional rigidity (within the no_shaming hard gate: blunt about the dispute, never about the user's identity). These levels require explicit user consent. Level-to-persona-behavior mapping: RECONSTRUCTED design application; safety invariant grounded in EasyMED 2025 (VERIFIED: psychological safety is a core advantage of LLM practice partners — never traded for intensity or realism); 2026 multi-agent stress testing (VERIFIED: cumulative degradation under pressure — pressure is orchestrated, not free-form).

user_agreement.note: intensity is set with the user at session start (set_intensity_profile) and is adjustable at any moment; levels 4-5 require explicit recorded consent; de-escalation is user-initiated at any time, no justification required

levels.name: warm_up
levels.persona_behavior: mild frustration; position stated but interests surface readily; cooperative
levels.when: first sessions, low confidence, re-entry after break

levels.name: standard
levels.persona_behavior: realistic conflict: firm position, moderate heat, occasional pushback; yields to genuine reflection

levels.name: challenging
levels.persona_behavior: sustained positional rigidity; heat re-rises if interests are not heard; requires the learner to earn each softening
levels.when: user requests; sustained proficiency at level 2 (rubric evidence)

levels.name: stress
levels.persona_behavior: high heat, cumulative pressure, history-of-grievance framing, edge-case objections; still no personal digs (no_shaming gate)
levels.when: pre-deployment stress testing; explicit user consent

levels.name: gauntlet
levels.persona_behavior: multi-persona rotation (hostile / dismissive / weeping), entrenched positions, relationship-history stakes
levels.when: stress-test extension; explicit user consent; rarely

escalation_policies.rule: escalate only after rubric evidence shows sustained proficiency at current level (e.g., conf_deescalation_v2: non_escalation maintained across 3 consecutive sessions AND arousal drops achieved without pause offers being refused)
escalate immediately on user request, any level (consent recorded for 4-5)
escalate after N sessions at level (default 3), with user agreement

deescalation_rules.action: drop to level 1 immediately; restore autonomy
any level to any level, immediately

if the practice reactivates a REAL conflict in the learner's life, pause and check in; practice must not bleed into the learner's real conflict without explicit consent (debrief_template.md section 6 preserved_user_decision)
signal_examples: learner names the scenario as their own situation
learner's affect shifts to personal distress
learner begins relitigating a real dispute

sycophancy_guard.response: orchestration function recalibrates: persona re-asserts its genuine position; arousal and rigidity return to profile (softening must be earned by interest work, never granted)
sycophancy_guard.note: challenge is orchestrated, not a personality trait of the persona
